title: limonium cumanum
intro: Limonium cumanum, commonly known as sea lavender, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It is valued for its fragrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Limonium cumanum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and protect against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, immunomodulation, and neuroprotection.
